opening.argument: The video presents Office 365 Education as practical classroom software, identifying tools for teachers and students rather than making a financial or investment proposition. OneNote is described as a place to organize lessons and distribute assignments, while Office Online supports students working together outside the classroom. The material also directs the educational audience to obtain the software through an Office or Microsoft destination and describes it as free. That instructional focus is reinforced by visible demonstrations of Sway and a teacher presenting OneNote to students, with no payment demand, credential request, investment claim, or other concrete mechanism for obtaining money or sensitive access.

citations.quote: It was full of powerful tools built just for teachers and students, and it was completely free!
OneNote provides one place to organize lessons and distribute assignments
With Office Online, students could work together, even outside the classroom.
